crossRefs.note: Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is no other. I am God, and there is none like me.
“For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; and the former things will not be remembered, nor come into mind.
you shall not be afraid of them. You shall remember well what Yahweh your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt:
You shall remember all the way which Yahweh your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might…
Remember his marvelous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
“Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that it will no more be said, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up the…
but, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the countries…
“Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that they will no more say, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up the…
but, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up and who led the offspring of the house of Israel out of the north country, and…
For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory…

translations.web: “Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old.
translations.bsb: “Do not call to mind the former things; pay no attention to the things of old.
translations.kjv: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.
translations.asv: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.
